artifacts.notes: 372-page whole-codex PDF. BLB catalogues 183 leaves. The scan is not a complete missal. Liturgical undertexts at named folios are separately segmented; their text is largely illegible at this resolution.
artifacts.rights_basis: The codex and its seventh/eighth-century palimpsest undertexts are public domain in the United States by age. The BLB title record for Cod. Aug. perg. 253 (https://digital.blb-karlsruhe.de/id/20478) marks the exact digitization Public Domain Mark 1.0 and requests source citation to Badische Landesbibliothek. PDM describes public-domain status; it is not a new licence. Register the unchanged 372-page PDF as the whole host codex, with Gallican/Gelasian/Missale fragments recorded only as bounded folio segments; do not label the full codex a missal.

edition.publication: Manuscript, probably Reichenau provenance; held by Badische Landesbibliothek Karlsruhe
edition.title: Cod. Aug. perg. 253, seventh-century host manuscript

work.author: Anonymous manuscript compilers; Jerome commentary in the host codex
work.description: The whole seventh-century Cod. Aug. perg. 253 is primarily a Jerome commentary host codex. Four distinct liturgical palimpsest undertexts are bounded constituents, not the whole book.
work.title: Karlsruhe, Badische Landesbibliothek, Cod. Aug. perg. 253
